name: 67th Annual Meeting of the Italian Economic Association (SIE RSA 2026)
organizer: Società Italiana degli Economisti (Italian Economic Association, SIE)
conf_dates_note: Starts Thursday afternoon, ends Saturday morning
deadline_note: Individual papers via Conference Maker from 10 Feb 2026 to 30 Apr 2026. Session proposals by individual members (up to 4 papers) were due by email 10 Feb-10 Apr 2026. Call closed.
submission_requirements: Full paper including abstract (max. 200 words), keywords and main JEL code; open to members and non-members; theoretical and applied papers
registration_fee: Before 30 Jun 2026 / after: EUR 230 / EUR 380 (incl. 2026/27 SIE membership); holders of 3-year membership expiring 30 Jun 2027 or later EUR 150 / EUR 300; PhD students and post-docs EUR 70 / EUR 90 (incl. membership)
membership_required: Registration includes 2026/27 SIE membership; paid registration required for inclusion in the programme
notification_date: Individual papers by 31 May 2026; organised sessions by 20 April 2026
